name: Craig G
hook: The Juice Crew's youngest member, whose one verse on a posse cut is still argued over as the best four bars in the genre's first decade.
blurb: Craig Curry joined Marley Marl's Juice Crew as a young teenager and released his first single, 'Droppin' Science', produced by Marl, in 1986. Two years later he was one of four MCs, alongside Kool G Rap, Big Daddy Kane and Masta Ace, on 'The Symphony', a posse cut built on a single Marley Marl loop that is still cited as one of the best rap records ever made. Craig G's verse on it is often singled out as the best, and regularly turns up in lists of the greatest verses. He was younger than most of his crewmates and never had a defining solo album the way Kool G Rap or Big Daddy Kane did, so he is still best known for that one guest verse, which shows how much a four-MC record could reward pure technical skill over a long career story.
